scope: Repair of confirmed code, performance, query duplication and configuration consistency findings in the existing working tree

fixes.unicode_previews: Native apply_text_edits with negotiated LSP encoding and source EOF options; preserve source buffers, executable annotations and resolved actions; normalize preview and error lines
fixes.rust_textobjects: Extend upstream queries, restore call argument swaps and inner objects, retain closures and macro interiors
fixes.tag_rpc_lifecycle: Dispatch exit once for graceful and forced termination
fixes.mason_installation: Use the lock for managed versions and Vue SDK; patch EFM in the staged package before promotion; reuse initialized Mason in the installer
fixes.shared_queries: One ECMA extension loaded once by JavaScript, TypeScript and inherited TSX queries
fixes.vue_sass: Scan only style contents; clear removed definitions and retain imports and variable aliases
fixes.consistency: Lua LF enforced by .gitattributes and StyLua; README matches actual mappings and active profile

performance.method: Same-process alternating before/after measurements; cached parse; component timings, not whole-editor latency

existing_changes_preserved: JSX/TSX tag action implementation and tests
limitations: Online registry refresh exceeded the existing command test wait on both baseline and repaired configurations; installation commands passed against the installed registry. Full online downloads were not rerun.
Mason staging regression substituted the download boundary and exercised the native runner, the real PowerShell checksum-success path, and injected patch failures. Fresh Go compilation was not rerun.
Full Node/Rust DAP matrix and cold startup/indexing of a large business project were not rerun.

additional_fixes: AnnotatedTextEdit: remove annotation references only in scratch preview copies, keeping confirmation on the executable action
EOF edits: match source eol, fixeol and binary options before native preview application
Normalize multiline resolver and edit-error messages before writing preview buffers
final_review.carried_forward: Remaining UI suites, installed plugin/tool checks and component performance measurements passed during repair and were not rerun in the final review
